issues.on_page: Parks & Recreation Fund: receipts 1,772.82, disbursements 20,543.35 (p13, unaudited combined statement)
issues.issue: The General Fund detail is incomplete because of the trim, not the extraction. The combining schedules on pp9-10 print only the General, Community Center and RV Park columns. Their receipts total 141,186.15, while the statement's General Fund column (p6) prints 142,958.97; the gap of 1,772.82 is the Parks & Recreation column. Their disbursements total 96,657.20 against 117,200.55 on p7; the gap of 20,543.35 is the same fund. The page with the Parks & Recreation column (source report around pp22/24) and the Sewer Fund proprietary budget page are not in the trimmed PDF. The extractor disclosed this in notes. The pages should be added via config/extra_pages.csv and the report re-trimmed.

The line is listed by object, and 74% of it is in the Street Fund column, so streets/highways is arguably the dominant function. general government is a defensible call under the listed-by-object rule.
